subject: Request: Route Acme traffic to APAC-only model v1.2 (exception)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Suneet Patel <suneet@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Route Acme traffic to APAC-only model v1.2 (exception)

Hi Aditya,

Quick one — Acme's security and product teams confirmed they can only accept inference that stays in their APAC tenancy and must use a specific model build (v1.2-quant) we've been testing. They asked whether we can make an exception to the normal routing/fallback policy so that: 

- All requests for Acme's account (ACME-POC-2026-03) are pinned to the APAC region
- No fallback to other regions or lower-tier model variants is permitted (forced model selection: v1.2-quant)

They've seen regressions with the fallback model in some edge cases for their enterprise dataset. Karthik, can infra confirm whether we can implement a per-account routing exception (route-only) and what telemetry/ops cost that adds? Marissa, can you confirm the commercial angle — any SLA or pricing implications?

I'm attaching the customer's exemption form and a short latency trace they captured. They want to start a short PoC tomorrow morning APAC time if we can scope the change quickly.

Thanks —
Lauren
--
Lauren Bishop
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Suneet Patel <suneet@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Route Acme traffic to APAC-only model v1.2 (exception)

Lauren / team —

Thanks, looping infra and runtime here. Short answer: we can support routing exceptions, but we need to agree on guardrails. Questions from my side: 

1) Is this a temporary PoC-only exception (48–72h) or a long-lived account-level policy?
2) If forced model selection is absolute (no fallback), we lose graceful degradation — are we OK with automatic retry to the same region if capacity is saturated?
3) What metrics and alerts should we create so SRE can act fast if this causes capacity pressure?

Karthik, any initial ETA to implement the route-only rule + model pin for a single account? If it's short (<8 hours) we can support the PoC window Lauren mentioned.

-Aditya
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Suneet Patel <suneet@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Route Acme traffic to APAC-only model v1.2 (exception)

On Wed, Mar 18, 2026 at 10:01 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com> wrote:
> Karthik, any initial ETA to implement the route-only rule + model pin for a single account?

We can make a scoped change in the routing layer to create a per-account override that says: route to APAC pool X and require model variant tag = "v1.2-quant". Implementation plan: 

- Add an override entry in the routing config (INF-config) keyed by account id; feature flag to enable per-account overrides. (ETA: ~4 hours to land a safe rollout)
- Add validation at request ingress to reject requests that would fall back to other regions/models when the override is active. That rejection returns 409 with clear reason. (ETA: ~6 hours)
- SRE: create temporary alarm on APAC pool utilization and queue-depth for the account. (ETA: ~2 hours once config is live)

Operational notes: 
- If the APAC pool is saturated, client will receive explicit failure (no silent fallback) — we should confirm Acme accepts that behavior.
- We need a short-lived capacity reservation or burst window for the PoC; otherwise we'll risk impacting other customers.

I can scope and prototype today; will need approval from product/CS to proceed.

Karthik
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Suneet Patel <suneet@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Route Acme traffic to APAC-only model v1.2 (exception)

Thanks — quick commercial notes: 

- For a PoC duration (48–72h) we can absorb a modest amount of extra ops; I'll mark this as a chargeable add-on if they want continuous account-level exclusivity.
- If routing prevents fallback and we see capacity failures, we should offer an "APAC reserved burst" package for the pilot: 4 GPU-hours/day for 7 days at a fixed rate.
- We'll need a signed exception doc from Acme acknowledging the impact to availability if region capacity is exhausted. Lauren — can you get that signed?

Marissa
Senior Manager, Partnerships & Pricing
From: Suneet Patel <suneet@acme.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 14:15:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Request: Route Acme traffic to APAC-only model v1.2 (exception)

Hi team,

Thanks for the quick responses. To confirm: this is a PoC for 72 hours starting Thursday APAC morning. We understand the risk of explicit failures if APAC capacity is maxed — acceptable for the PoC. We'll sign the exception form Lauren attached and we agree to the reserved burst if you recommend it.

Suneet
Chief Product Officer
Acme AI
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Route Acme traffic to APAC-only model v1.2 (exception)

All right — plan of record: 

1) Karthik will land a per-account routing override + ingress validation today (feature flag gated). ETA: 6 hours.
2) Marissa will provision a small reserved burst for the PoC and provide pricing.
3) Lauren to collect the signed exemption form from Acme (attach to the ticket).
4) SRE will provision alerts and temporarily raise APAC pool capacity if needed during the 72h window.

We will gate the rollout behind a single smoke test from Acme once the flag is enabled. Karthik — please create INF-4287 and assign to SRE for alerting (I see a related Jira link in the metadata).

I'll keep Suneet and Acme updated on the rollout timeline. Thanks everyone for quick turn.

-Aditya
